# Daxo OS Proof Archive

> A raw, unfiltered visual log and chronological archive of building a custom x86_64 Rust microkernel from absolute scratch.

## Overview
This website hosts an automated gallery of over 80 development screenshots documenting the engineering of Daxo OS. 

## Key Categories & Architecture
- **Bootloader & VGA:** Initial Real Mode/Protected Mode transitions and text output buffers.
- **Memory & Paging:** 4-level paging tables setup and virtual memory isolation in Rust.
- **ATA & Drivers:** Low-level hardware drivers and storage communication.
- **Ring 3 / User Space:** Cooperative multitasking, custom async task executors, and user-space separation.

## Links
- Website: https://daxo-developer.github.io/daxo-os-gallery-web/
